ack.accept_if: frame CRC/version/type/flags/length valid, header_seq == payload_seq == current outstanding seq AND same link session
ack.duplicate_or_delayed_current: accept once, cancel retry; further identical ACK ignored
ack.stale_previous_or_future: ignore, log, never release current replay

nack.current_expected: only retransmit same outstanding packet if header and expected both equal current outstanding seq, bounded retry
nack.stale_or_future: ignore, never infer acceptance from NACK
nack.expected_is_outstanding_plus_one: do_not_treat_as_ACK; accepted duplicate will generate exact ACK

control_sequence_R2.incoming_future_or_conflicting: reject/NACK when valid; no app side effect

terminal_commit_R2.original_COMMIT_frame: new FPGA_TO_PC seq S, whole wire retained through exact ACK
terminal_commit_R2.outstanding_COMMIT_retry: exact identical wire image and S; never new seq

terminal_commit_R2.QUERY_reply: new FPGA_TO_PC reliable sequence T only after earlier outstanding FPGA frame resolved or approved new link-session reconciliation; same immutable CPI_ID/outcome/count but NOT same wire image
terminal_commit_R2.QUERY_during_outstanding_COMMIT: ACK incoming QUERY control response, replay original outstanding S bytes and S, on valid S ACK emit deferred query STATUS with fresh FPGA reliable T and same immutable terminal result; never overtake S

terminal_commit_R2.no_COMMIT_at_host: uncommitted, even if all targets arrived
terminal_commit_R2.new_CPI_gate: terminal outcome reconciled, explicit release and fresh unique CPI_ID
